description: Promotion ladder priority — encodes the order in which V5 service tries the promoted (non-R-rule) caption sources. First entry whose `when` matches the facts wins. Tier 1 entries (trap_setup, trap_defense, opening) OVERRIDE any existing caption. Tier 2 entries (shape, principle, basic_mistake) FILL only when caption_empty=true. The `source_template` is the rule_name suffix written into the move record so authoring tools can attribute each fired caption to a specific rule.

fact_glossary.caption_empty: true when the R-rule layer left no caption — gates the Tier 2 fill paths
fact_glossary.is_user: true when the just-moved side is the user
fact_glossary.best_move_differs: true when best_move is present AND != move_san
fact_glossary.trap_record.this_move_by_user: true when the trap-related move is by the user
fact_glossary.opening_record.name: Set on the first move that matched ≥3 setup steps of a named opening
fact_glossary.shape_pattern_name: Authored geometric pattern name (set when a shape pattern fired this move)
fact_glossary.principle_cue: Authored principle teaching note (set when a principle fired this move)
